summary: On paper Carolina has the edge (Carolina ranks 6th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.11). The model favors Carolina at 57%, mostly on rushing matchup (2.6 pts) and starting QB (1.7 pts).

CAR.detail: Carolina ranks 6th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.11). Cleveland's defense ranks 18th (+0.08 allowed).

CLE.detail: Cleveland's defense ranks 18th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.08 allowed). Carolina ranks 6th (+0.11).

team_cards.t1: Carolina has the 6th-best motion passing game.
team_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · FTN CHARTING VIA NFLVERSE
team_cards.note: Garbage time removed · CAR: n=38 dropbacks

model.summary: Model: Carolina 57% to win, fair line CAR -2. Market: Carolina 55%. The largest factor is rushing matchup, worth 2.6 points toward Carolina.

model_cards.t1: The model agrees with the market.
model_cards.sub: Win probability. Market = vig-free moneyline at build time.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Not betting advice · market line at build time

model_cards.sub: Each factor's push on the projected margin, in points. Positive = toward Cleveland. Sum = CAR -2.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Linear model, so contributions are exact SHAP values · vs. an average matchup

model_cards.sub: Distribution of Cleveland's margin. Shaded area = Cleveland win (43%).
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Normal margin, sigma = 12.0 points (fit by log loss)

model_cards.t1: Carolina is missing 1.7 starters' worth of snaps.
model_cards.t2: Injuries move the line 0.9 points toward Cleveland.
model_cards.sub: Players listed Out, Doubtful or Questionable, weighted by recent snap share. QBs are in the QB factor.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Weight = snap share (last 4 games) x status (Out 1.0, Doubtful 0.85, Questionable 0.25)

model_cards.t1: The biggest unit gap: Carolina's pass offense.
model_cards.t2: 0.06 EPA per play better than Cleveland's.
model_cards.sub: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play vs. league average, the inputs to the model. Right = better.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Recency-weighted, last season's plays at 35% weight

model_cards.t2: It trails the market: Brier 0.226 vs. 0.211.
model_cards.sub: Walk-forward backtest, 2018-2025 (2087 games). Each season uses only earlier data.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Brier score: lower is better · market = closing line

recap.text: Browns 21, Panthers 18. The model had the Panthers at 57% (miss). Panthers won 1 of 1 keys · Browns won 0 of 1 keys.
